name: National Molding
old_description: Global Manufacturer of Precision Engineered Plastic Components
about:
National Molding was founded in 1982 in Miami Lakes, Florida. The company began as an injection molding specialist and developed the proprietary Hetero-Cavity technology that remains central to its operations.

Today National Molding operates plants in the United States, Canada, and China, producing over 3.5 billion precision plastic parts annually. Its manufacturing capabilities span precision injection molding (40–300 ton machines), medical molding in an ISO Class 8 cleanroom, insert and over molding, metal-to-plastic conversions, low-cost modular molding, and a full-service tool room with CNC machining. The company also provides design for manufacturability, material science support, pre- and post-molding services, and assembly.

The customer base is diverse: over 60 percent of output serves Tier 1, Tier 2, and OEM automotive programs. The remainder includes DuraflexUSA buckles and fasteners for sporting goods, pet supplies, and military/tactical markets; sophisticated release systems for body armor used by military and law enforcement; and medical devices and assemblies for healthcare, life science, dental, and diagnostic sectors. Commercial clients span plumbing fixtures, telecommunications, appliances, irrigation, furniture, marine, and electrical products.

National Molding differentiates itself through its Hetero-Cavity® system, which enables high-volume production of small, complex parts with minimal lead time, and through its global footprint that supports Berry Amendment and Buy America Act compliance for domestic programs.
